mapper.select: SELECT MAP_ID, MAP_NM, WIDTH, HEIGHT, BG_URL FROM TB_LAYOUT_MAP WHERE USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_ORD, MAP_ID

SELECT I.MAP_ID, I.ITEM_ID, I.ITEM_NM, I.ITEM_TYPE, I.POS_X, I.POS_Y, I.WIDTH, I.HEIGHT, I.ROTATE, I.SHAPE, I.USER_ID, U.USER_NM FROM TB_LAYOUT_ITEM I LEFT JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = I.USER_ID WHERE I.MAP_ID = #{mapId} ORDER BY I.ITEM_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_LAYOUT_ITEM (MAP_ID, ITEM_ID, ITEM_NM, ITEM_TYPE, POS_X, POS_Y, WIDTH, HEIGHT, ROTATE, SHAPE, USER_ID, REG_ID, REG_DT) VALUES (#{r.mapId}, #{r.itemId}, #{r.itemNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{r.itemType}, COALESCE(ROUND(CAST(#{r.posX,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS NUMERIC)), 0), COALESCE(ROUND(CAST(#{r.posY,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS NUMERIC)), 0), ROUND(CAST(#{r.width,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS NUMERIC)), ROUND(CAST(#{r.height,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS NUMERIC)), COALESCE(CAST(#{r.rotate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS INTEGER), 0), COALESCE(#{r.shape,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'rect'), #{r.userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{loginId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_LAYOUT_ITEM WHERE MAP_ID = #{r.mapId} AND ITEM_ID = #{r.itemId}
